assessmentReviewNote: Both course pages retain a generic marketing block referring to a final exam. Their course-specific grading and requirements expressly state no final exam, chapter tests and applied assignments, with 70% overall required. The specific syllabus governs this assessment record. ACE's broader assessment categories are retained separately without relabeling them as a current final-exam requirement.
